  - heading "For everything worth reading and writing" [level=2]
  - heading "Kindle is built for following your curiosity, with nothing to pull you away. Stay as long as you like." [level=3]
  - img "Person sitting by window reading on Kindle devices."
  - heading "Skip the scroll" [level=2]
  - text: Settle into one page and stay there. No notifications, no feeds, nothing asking for your attention.
  - link "Discover Reading on Kindle":
    - /url: https://amazon.com/b?node=210710937011
  - img "Person sitting on wooden floor reading on Kindle devices."
  - heading "Dive into color" [level=2]
  - text: Kindle Colorsoft brings covers, comics, and graphic novels to life in paper-like color.
  - link "Discover Color on Kindle":
    - /url: https://amazon.com/b?node=210710945011
  - img "Person writing on Kindle devices with stylus at wooden desk."
  - heading "Think it. Ink it." [level=2]
  - text: Turn a passing thought into a note, with all the feel of pen on real paper.
  - link "Discover Work & Productivity on Kindle Scribe":

  - paragraph: Explore the latest from Kindle. It changes, so check back.

  - button "Next slide"
  - heading "Which Kindle is for you?" [level=2]
  - text: Every Kindle reads like paper. Choose yours based on size, color, and whether you want to write on it—then add an accessory to make it your own.
  - img "Person holding coffee and Kindle devices while walking outdoors."
  - img "Four Kindle devices in different colors displaying book pages, arranged side by side."
  - button "Open card for more information"
  - heading "Kindle" [level=3]
  - paragraph: For reading and nothing else. Paper-like display, weeks of battery, zero pings.
  - 'img "Three Kindle devices displaying different content: a nature scene with text, a circular chart, and a city illustration with text."'
  - button "Open card for more information"
  - heading "Kindle Scribe" [level=3]
  - paragraph: For note-taking, journaling, and thinking on paper. For reading too.
  - img "Close-up of Kindle devices fabric cover corner in purple."
  - button "Open card for more information"
  - heading "Kindle accessories" [level=3]
  - paragraph: "New ways to charge and turn the page: covers with buttons and Kindle Click."
  - heading "Millions of titles. One tap away." [level=2]
  - text: The Kindle Store offers instant access to millions of titles worldwide, including bestsellers and Kindle Exclusives you won’t find anywhere else. Subscribe to Kindle Unlimited to read many of them anytime, and use the Kindle app to keep everything in sync.
  - link "Learn more about content and subscriptions available with Kindle.":
    - /url: https://www.amazon.com/kindle/explore-more-content
  - button "Play"
  - img "Kindle devices displaying the Kindle Store with book covers recently included with membership."
  - heading "Kindle Unlimited" [level=3]
  - text: With a
  - link "Kindle Unlimited":
    - /url: https://www.amazon.com/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku
  - text: subscription, you can explore a wide selection of ebooks and audiobooks across your favorite genres, from familiar favorites to your next unexpected find.
  - img "Hand holding phone displaying Kindle devices app with library of book covers including titles by Dan Brown, Stephen King, and Jojo Moyes."
  - heading "The Kindle app" [level=2]
  - text: Read your books on any smartphone or tablet with the Kindle app, picking up right where you left off. You can also view your Kindle Scribe notebooks so they’re always at hand.
  - heading "Read and write your way" [level=2]
  - text: Kindle is built with accessibility features, so you can enjoy a reading experience that works for you.
  - img "Person sitting outdoors holding Kindle devices while writing."
  - heading "Accessibility on Kindle" [level=2]
  - heading "See it your way" [level=2]
  - text: Set the font, size, spacing, and margins. Choose bold text or OpenDyslexic, and adjust the warm light or switch to dark mode.
  - heading "Hear it read aloud" [level=2]
  - text: VoiceView reads the screen out loud, so you can navigate your library and your books without looking at them.
  - heading "Write it by hand" [level=2]
  - text: On Kindle Scribe, write and mark up right on the page, then convert your handwriting to text when you need it.
  - heading "For more information" [level=2]
  - text: "*Some features are only available on certain Kindle devices. For more information about Kindle accessibility features, go to"
